maddeler.e:
أعتصم (form VIII)
# أَعْتَصِمُ (ʔaʕtaṣimu) /ʔaʕ.ta.sˤi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# أُعْتَصَمُ (ʔuʕtaṣamu) /ʔuʕ.ta.sˤa.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# أَعْتَصِمَ (ʔaʕtaṣima) /ʔaʕ.ta.sˤi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# أُعْتَصَمَ (ʔuʕtaṣama) /ʔuʕ.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
